description: Severe-duty low-voltage NEMA motor combining flexibility, performance and efficiency. Built to power fans, compressors, pumps, conveyors in harsh environments.
differentiators: Field-modifiable terminal box (switch between F1 and F2)
NEMA Premium® and DoE efficiency standards compliance

description: Severe duty cast-iron motor delivering NEMA Super Premium® (IE4) efficiency. Designed to withstand the harshest operating conditions with superior protection against dust, moisture and extreme temperatures.
Based on the NEMA IEEE 841 severe duty line, designed for use in aggressive environments such as Petrochemical Industry, Process Plants, Pulp and Paper and Steel Mills.
differentiators: Premium Efficiency IE3 according to IEC 60034-30-1
Aerodynamic fan design and solid feet for reduced vibration
